blogs.title: Not All Early-Onset Diabetes Is T1 or T2: Spotting HNF1A-MODY at the Front Door
blogs.description: Using this young man with severe hyperglycaemia, glycosuria, negative autoantibodies, and preserved C-peptide as a springboard, we outline the bedside clues that should trigger MODY consideration. Practical takeaways include the weight/BMI trap, the value of postprandial testing, and how a three-generation family history can change management.

blogs.title: The Glycosuria Tell: Low Renal Glucose Threshold as a Clue to HNF1A-MODY
blogs.description: Why significant glycosuria without ketoacidosis matters. A quick physiology refresher on HNF1A regulation of SGLT2, how this lowers the renal glucose threshold, and how to leverage this sign when differentiating MODY from type 1 and type 2 diabetes.

blogs.title: C-Peptide and Antibodies Won’t Save You: Diagnostic Pitfalls in MODY
blogs.description: How preserved stimulated C-peptide and negative GAD/IA-2 tilt the odds but don’t definitively sort MODY from T1/T2. We discuss timing of testing, occasional autoantibody positivity in MODY, and how to integrate these results with clinical phenotype and OGTT findings.

blogs.title: When to Order MODY Genetics: A Pragmatic Pathway (and Why Calculators Can Mislead)
blogs.description: A practical algorithm for who gets genetic testing, including thresholds based on age at onset, family history, autoantibodies, C-peptide, and postprandial hyperglycaemia. We review the Exeter MODY probability calculator’s strengths and its limitations in non-European populations.

blogs.title: Insulin Off-Ramp: De-escalating After MODY Confirmation
blogs.description: This case illustrates safe withdrawal of basal insulin after initial stabilization and genetic diagnosis. We cover selection and timing of non-insulin agents, monitoring during the transition, and red flags for relapse.

blogs.title: Sulfonylurea or GLP-1 RA for HNF1A-MODY? Balancing Physiology, Evidence, and Patient Priorities
blogs.description: Classically, HNF1A-MODY is sulfonylurea-sensitive—but hypoglycaemia and weight gain are real. We appraise the limited randomized data on GLP-1 RAs, discuss when GLP-1–based therapy may be preferable, and outline a patient-centered approach to agent selection.

blogs.title: SGLT2 Inhibitors in HNF1A-MODY: Proceed with Caution
blogs.description: HNF1A downregulates SGLT2, predisposing to glycosuria. We explore why adding pharmacologic SGLT2 inhibition may amplify dehydration risk and potentially precipitate ketoacidosis, and offer pragmatic guidance if these agents are being considered for cardiorenal indications.

blogs.title: Postprandial Spikes Without DKA: The OGTT as a Diagnostic Lever
blogs.description: In this patient, the 2-hour OGTT was striking and more informative than fasting values. We discuss how exaggerated postprandial hyperglycaemia can point toward beta-cell defects like HNF1A-MODY and when to deploy OGTT in busy clinical practice.

blogs.title: Novel Variant, Real Disease: How to Interpret HNF1A Results Beyond ClinVar
blogs.description: A walk-through of applying ACMG criteria to a previously unreported HNF1A variant. We cover segregation, domain location, in silico tools, and why absence from databases doesn’t equal benign. Tips for reporting back to patients and triggering cascade testing.

blogs.title: MODY in the Metabolic Syndrome Era: Don’t Let BMI Blind You
blogs.description: This patient had features suggestive of metabolic syndrome—yet genetically confirmed HNF1A-MODY. We review how rising obesity blurs phenotype-based heuristics and propose updated criteria that preserve sensitivity without overwhelming genetic services.

blogs.title: Early Neuropathy in MODY? Making Sense of Sudomotor Dysfunction at Diagnosis
blogs.description: Severely reduced hand sudomotor conductance was an unexpected finding. We discuss what’s known (and unknown) about early small fiber/autonomic involvement in MODY, alternative explanations, and how this should influence complication screening and follow-up.

blogs.title: Turning One Diagnosis Into Many: Family Cascade Testing and Precision Therapy in HNF1A-MODY
blogs.description: How identifying a proband with HNF1A-MODY can unlock targeted testing and tailored therapy across a family. Practical steps for cascade testing, counseling, and aligning treatments with genotype and residual beta-cell function.
